goal: Replace status-only heavy health follow-up with a persisted revision-gated policy, preserve daily full WebSim reconciliation, and add a manual locked SimC-only talent graph recovery entrypoint.
userValue: A normal bugfix no longer risks restarting broad background collection, while a proved talent-graph incident has one observable, bounded recovery path.
nonGoals: No full Journal, loot, or catalog incremental-write rewrite
No new external source, dependency installation, migration, or deploy-triggered asynchronous sync
No automatic talent graph repair or automatic full WebSim continuation
No public gear/talent source-quality semantic change

mustChange: data health and talent recovery runbook
riskUnknown: Each external source must expose an explicit stable revision before automated heavy follow-up is permitted.
A failed asynchronous unit cannot authorize same-revision retry without a new revision or explicit operator action.
evidenceRequired: Red-green unit tests for baseline, changed revision, explicit refresh, missing revision, forced recovery, and no automatic full WebSim
PostgreSQL sync-state ownership and health consumer tests
Candidate backup, exact runtime identity, unit/timer/log/API/data smoke, and rollback evidence

ownership.factOwner: server/postgres_cache_store.py owns cache.websim_sync_state; server/data_health_followup.py is a policy consumer/orchestrator; server/news_backend.py is a health consumer.

engineeringHealth.reason: The task changes a scheduled write-path orchestrator. It adds a small policy boundary, reuses the existing state repository, claims action state before launch, keeps full sync out of health follow-up, and requires candidate backup/rollback evidence.

decisionLog.decision: The user approved revision-gated health follow-up and a manual SimC-only talent recovery path; broad WebSim continuation is intentionally not automated.

acceptanceEvidence: python3 -m unittest tests.data_health_followup_test tests.websim_sync_test tests.postgres_cache_store_test tests.postgres_cache_sync_test tests.deploy_lighthouse_test
candidate backup, runtime parity, read-only preflight, forced SimC-only recovery, health/API/unit/timer/log smoke and rollback evidence
